schedule.comment: slots[] is the single source of truth for the six-post rotation (1 BTC outlook, 1 community meme, 4 explained setups). bot/schedule.py serves pending slots in order across UTC dates; min_gap_minutes=230 targets roughly six scheduled posts per day. A stable per-slot random delay of 3–40 minutes avoids publishing at a fixed minute. Changing the slot list starts a fresh rotation automatically. Explicit type/slot requests or reset can publish extras.

duplicate_filter_comment: Keep a full 24-hour per-coin cooldown for the four-setup rotation. Legacy deployments may explicitly configure a shorter fallback; direction, RR and momentum gates are never bypassed.

trending.comment: Only candidates meeting min_change_percent are considered. An empty min_change_fallbacks means a quiet market produces no signal rather than relaxing into a weak mover. exclude_coins omits tokenized stocks and gold-linked markets from crypto setups.
trending.score_comment: Composite topic score: 24h momentum, intraday range, quote volume, trade count (audience relevance) and a novelty bonus decaying over 7 days since the coin was last posted. Selection picks the highest-scoring unblocked candidate, not just the top gainer.

content.comment: Signal hooks are capped at 70 characters and signal posts use no more than two relevant crypto cashtag occurrences (no duplicates). Keep CTAs contextual and avoid repeating unavailable-data notices.
